body_markdown:
Douglas Dynamics’ President and CEO, Mark Van Genderen, was recently featured in the Milwaukee Business Journal. The article highlights Mark’s unique hands-on leadership style and extensive experience in the manufacturing.


In the interview, Mark shares his leadership philosophy, emphasizing the importance of understanding the work firsthand and leading with both strategy and empathy. He also reflects on his path to Douglas Dynamics and how his prior experience has shaped his approach to navigating challenges and positioning the company for long-term success.


As President and CEO, Mark remains focused on driving growth, fostering innovation, and continuing to strengthen the company’s position as a leader in the work truck industry.


Read the full article here: *[https://bizj.us/1qnhcl](https://bizj.us/1qnhcl)*
